ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a central intersection point O, and several edges connect outward from O, forming a triangle below, two squares on the left and right, and a parallelogram above. The two sides of the lower triangle respectively coincide with one side of the two squares; the two adjacent sides of the upper parallelogram follow the directions of the other set of corresponding sides of these two squares starting from O. Reasoning: Let the lower triangle be triangle AOB, where OA and OB are the sides respectively shared with the two squares. The problem gives the side lengths of the two squares as 4 mm and 5 mm, so OA=4, OB=5. Let the angle between OA and OB be theta. The area of the triangle is 8 mm^2, therefore 8 = (1/2)(4)(5)sin(theta). So (4)(5)sin(theta)=16. The adjacent sides of the upper parallelogram are obtained from OA and OB by rotating 90 degrees through the square structure, and the sine value of the corresponding included angle is the same, therefore the area of the parallelogram is (4)(5)sin(theta)=16.

raw_record.question_text: The diagram shows a square with sides of length $4 \mathrm{~mm}$, a square with sides of length $5 \mathrm{~mm}$, a triangle with area $8 \mathrm{~mm}^{2}$, and a parallelogram. What is the area, in $\mathrm{mm}^{2}$, of the parallelogram? <image1>

method.method_draft: Label the central meeting point of the shapes as O, and the bottom triangle as triangle AOB, where OA and OB are the sides shared with the two squares. From the image, read that the top parallelogram has its two adjacent sides along the other sides of those same two squares, starting from O. From the text, read that the two square side lengths are 4 mm and 5 mm and that the area of triangle AOB is 8 mm^2. Let theta be the angle between OA and OB in the triangle. Then 8 = (1/2)(4)(5)sin(theta). Because the adjacent sides of the parallelogram are obtained by rotating OA and OB by 90 degrees through the square constructions, the included angle in the parallelogram has the same sine as theta. Therefore the parallelogram area is (4)(5)sin(theta), which is twice the triangle area, giving 16.

method.method_draft: Label the two sides of the bottom triangle from the central point O as vectors u and v. From the image, observe that the adjacent sides of the upper parallelogram are the sides of the two squares perpendicular to u and v, respectively. Thus those parallelogram side vectors are u and v rotated 90 degrees in opposite directions. From the text, use that the bottom triangle has area 8 mm^2. The area of triangle AOB is (1/2)|u x v|, so |u x v| = 16. Rotating one vector 90 degrees clockwise and the other 90 degrees counterclockwise changes only the sign of the cross product, not its absolute value. Therefore the parallelogram area is the absolute cross product of its adjacent side vectors, also 16.

图像描述：图中有一个公共中心点 O。O 向下连到左下点 A 和右下点 B，形成底部三角形 AOB；题目给出该三角形面积为 8 mm²。左侧和右侧分别有正方形，它们分别以 OA、OB 作为一条边向外作出。上方的四边形是要求面积的平行四边形，它在 O 处的两条相邻边分别与 OA、OB 垂直，是这两个正方形的边。

推理：令向量 u = OA，v = OB。底部三角形面积为 (1/2)|u × v| = 8，所以 |u × v| = 16。由图可见，上方平行四边形的两条相邻边分别是 u 和 v 各旋转 90° 后得到的向量，而且旋转方向相反。把一个向量顺时针旋转 90°、另一个向量逆时针旋转 90°，只会改变叉积符号，不改变叉积绝对值。因此平行四边形面积等于这两条相邻边向量叉积的绝对值，也就是 |u × v| = 16。
